name: LIVEN 8bit warps
description: 8-bit waveform memory synth engine for creating a wide variety of sounds from Chiptune to Ambient. Unique sound creation with aliasing noise on/off, detune and sweep functions. 128-step sequencer with parameter locking. 4-track looper for recording internal audio and external audio. 10 effects and 6 reverbs (switchable to the Cassette tape simulator)
